mount_rejection: Old P_REAR bbox below is historical side-layout, not current open-deck. Current planning box [2.5,-11,109,39.5,11,120] gives minimum67.684932mm to fuse reservation. Reposition F_PWM before using this mount; do not extend unfused XP01.
purpose: Replace only the R4 F_PWM 372/570/575 panel fuse with a higher-DC-interrupt axial fuse; retain the PWM5 circuit, P0, AUX6 and all 15 drives.

fuse.type: axial leaded, soldered into replaceable fixed pigtail; NOT a TR5 cartridge

circuit_unchanged: P_REAR.4 after F0/S1 -> XP01 -> F_PWM 0.1A -> XP02 -> L78L05ACZ VIN; XP03 return to G_TAIL.3. PWM5 powers only U1 logic, not MG92B motors.

mount_plan_world_mm.meaning: Planning clearance only; sleeve, tie head, solder joints, cavity and actual wire bend are not modeled.

assembly_sequence: With every source disconnected, solder the 242 into one replaceable 0.5 mm2 fixed pigtail; separately insulate both joints and the fuse assembly with appropriately rated sleeves chosen for the actual diameters.

Anchor the sleeved body against the underside of the selected P10 at the two dedicated 4x2 mm slots with an existing 2.5 mm tie; restrain both conductors independently so no wire force reaches either fuse lead.

Terminate XP01 in the nearer physically available P_REAR.4 cavity. Its entire unfused length from cavity to fuse lead, including insulation exits, bend and slack, must be <=50 mm; do not add a 30 mm service allowance before the fuse.
Route XP02 to the existing fixed PWM carrier input. Do not connect the signal ground as the motor-current return; preserve existing JPWM and U1 wiring.
For service, remove battery and other supplies, lift the removable E6 cover, disconnect fixed Deck wiring, lift Deck and replace the fused pigtail as a unit. No live fuse replacement.
before_first_power: Verify the actual battery/source prospective short current and upstream F0 interruption/coordination; 30C is not a short-circuit current measurement.
Check regulator startup and normal current against 242 time-current and ambient derating; the existing circuit has only 0.33uF input capacitance in its draft, but populated hardware is not measured.
Confirm fuse SKU, sleeve dielectric/thermal suitability, solder workmanship, cover clearance, conductor strain relief and actual XP01 <=50 mm route.
Verify polarity, continuity, insulation, switch-off and temperature on the assembled unpowered/controlled bench before enabling any motors.
